moments.evidence: Una nina de roba seu al cantell d’una caixa baixa. La pala de joguina és més enllà.
La part plana de la pala, guiada amb cura, empeny el peu de la nina endavant mentre la nina perd la base del seient.
La nina reposa d’esquena a terra davant de la caixa i encara es veu la pala.

continuity.anchor: Una nina amb dos botons cosits i una pala de punta arrodonida.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic squirrel; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Una nina de roba seu al cantell d’una caixa baixa. La pala de joguina és més enllà. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: La part plana de la pala, guiada amb cura, empeny el peu de la nina endavant mentre la nina perd la base del seient. RIGHT result: La nina reposa d’esquena a terra davant de la caixa i encara es veu la pala. Continuity and accounting: Una nina amb dos botons cosits i una pala de punta arrodonida. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Use a low front three-quarter view, stool is at far right. Small inert stuffed rag doll seated facing diagonally toward viewer and image LEFT, with lively red boots, two yellow sewn buttons. Adult squirrel is off to the left but reaches an orange scoop flat along floor and around to the REAR of the nearer boot from just to the side. In middle make the scoop touch ONLY the heel of a red boot with its brightly colored broad edge, the doll's boot has been displaced along floor AWAY from the box and toward foreground LEFT, doll pelvis is slipping off the front edge and arms hang limp. For clarity the orange scoop does NOT go above the red boot's ankle, and does not touch the stool, body or clothing at all. Final doll supine in front-left of stool, with both same boots, toy shovel separated in squirrel hands. Keep box fixed and its sides parallel under perspective.
attempts.review: La pala encaixa sota la sola vermella i desplaça visiblement el peu per davant del cantell de la caixa. La nina de dos botons perd suport i acaba d’esquena a terra.
